XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Front windshield wiper and washer inactive; rear wipers operating smoothly
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: AIRBAG | B1008 | B101B | LIGHT INDICATOR | ON | ON | RED | RED | IGNITION | ACTIVE | FUNCTIONING | INACTIVE | BUZZER | CONTACT | ROTATING | SPIRAL | SPIRALED | DRUM |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Airbag

  • Device: Rotary switch

  • Fault: Airbag warning light illuminated with occasional failure of the audible warning signal

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis:
  • B1008 (Driver airbag resistor, 1st level)
  • B101B (Driver airbag 2nd stage resistor)
  • Cause: Faulty rotary contact

• Action: Check that the rotary contact is working correctly and replace it if necessary

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: The rotary switch in question is supplied complete with a light switch, and following its replacement, no reprogramming via diagnostic equipment was required, thereby permanently resolving the fault.

    The estimated time for the repair is approximately 1.5 hours.
